declaration.preface:
Advanced Supply Chain Group Limited (ASCG), a Reconomy Group company, is committed to environmental stewardship and responsible operations aligned with Reconomy’s sustainability ambitions. As part of our shared vision for a circular, low-carbon economy, we have developed this Environmental Management Roadmap outlines our strategic targets, key initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts..

This roadmap consolidates ASCG’s environmental commitments under key themes such as energy efficiency, GHG reduction, circularity, and employee advocacy — all designed to support compliance with ISO 14001:2015 and Reconomy’s ESG performance expectations.
declaration.declaration:
ASCG is committed to achieving the following general environmental objectives:

Compliance with all applicable legal, regulatory, and other obligations related to environmental performance.

Prevention of pollution and minimisation of adverse environmental impacts through effective risk management.

Continuous improvement of the Environmental Management System (EMS) in line with ISO 14001:2015 standards.

Integration of environmental considerations into decision-making processes, operational controls, and procurement.

Sustainability awareness and culture throughout all levels of the organisation and its supply chain.

This Environmental Roadmap is endorsed by ASCG senior leadership and reaffirms our responsibility to operate sustainably, reduce our carbon footprint, and help shape a circular economy — in alignment with Reconomy Group’s corporate vision.
declaration.scope:
This Environmental Management Roadmap applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and any individuals acting on behalf of Advanced Supply Chain Group Limited (ASCG).

It covers all ASCG operational, administrative, and strategic activities across the following sites and regions:

General environmental objectives: Compliance with all applicable legal, regulatory, and other obligations related to environmental performance.
Prevention of pollution and minimisation of adverse environmental impacts through effective risk management.
Continuous improvement of the Environmental Management System (EMS) in line with ISO 14001:2015 standards.
Integration of environmental considerations into decision-making processes, operational controls, and procurement.
Sustainability awareness and culture throughout all levels of the organisation and its supply chain.
Energy Efficiency and Resource Use: We aim to transition to renewable energy sources, reducing dependency on non-renewable sources.
Greenhouse Gas Emissions (GHG): Supported by the evaluation of low-emission fleet technologies and the integration of carbon-reduction strategies into logistics, procurement, and operational planning.
Waste Management and Circularity: Through staff engagement on the waste hierarchy and replacing plastic packaging materials with sustainable alternatives.
Replacing it with recyclable or certified compostable alternatives across all fulfilment centres.
Environmental Services & Advocacy: To promote hands-on sustainability and environmental responsibility across all sites.
ASCG will launch a “Green Logistics Innovation Program” to collect employee ideas on sustainability.

targets.target: Sourcing 100% of electricity from solar or wind power at our UK and international sites
Cut Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions per unit shipped by 33.6%
Achieve 100% waste diversion from landfill across all sites
Eliminate 100 % of single‑use plastic packaging in outbound logistics
Organise at least three employee-led environmental activities annually — such as tree plantation drives, local clean-up events, or recycling awareness campaigns
ASCG will launch a “Green Logistics Innovation Program” by 2028 to collect employee ideas on sustainability and implement at least one initiative per year that drives measurable impact.
targets.deadline: 2028 and at least one initiative per year thereafter

responsibilities.duty: Approval of targets, and annual environmental plans
Implementation, monitoring, legal compliance, EMS audits, and incident investigation
Local engagement, training delivery, and issue identification
Adherence to EMS procedures and proactive participation in sustainability practices

policy.monitoring:
Implementation, monitoring, legal compliance, EMS audits, and incident investigation

Training and refresher sessions are delivered to ensure alignment and participation.

policy.reviewMechanism:
The roadmap will be reviewed annually by the Environmental Compliance Officer or sooner in response to:

Changes in operations or environmental legislation

Environmental incidents or audit findings

Stakeholder or management feedback

Changes to Reconomy Group sustainability strategies

The Management Review will evaluate effectiveness, alignment with group strategy, and opportunities for improvement.
